title: ArchSieve affected 0.3
description: Reverse import closure of a set of changed files, the tests inside it, and every known reason it may be incomplete.

base.description: The git ref the changed files were read from (git diff --name-only).

changed.description: Changed paths, relative to the scanned directory.

files.description: Snapshot node ids of the changed files and every file or Go package that imports them, directly or indirectly.

tests.description: The part of files marked test in the snapshot.

blind.description: Why files may be incomplete. Empty means nothing known is missing, not that the answer is proven complete (see limitations).
